Halls and addresses

Where we train in Copenhagen

Talata trains in six halls across Copenhagen, most of it on Østerbro. Here is every hall, its address, and who trains there and when. Holiday camps run at Hafnia-Hallen.

Book a free first session
  • Svanemøllehallen
  • Strandvejsskolen
  • Kulturhuset Indre By
  • Nørre Fælled Skole
  • Bellahøj Hallerne
  • Nørrebrohallen
  • Hafnia-Hallen

Times come straight from our schedule and update on their own. Holiday changes show on each team’s page under This week.

Svanemøllehallen Home court

Østerbrogade 240, 2100 København Ø

Who trains here
Mon 16:45 to 18:45 U15 + U17 from 19 Oct, Mon 18:45 to 20:15 U19 + Men, Tue 18:45 to 20:00 U19 + Men, Thu 17:00 to 19:00 U13 Academy + U15 + U17
Good to know
Our home court, next to Svanemøllen station.

Academy · Talata Men · Games

Strandvejsskolen

Sionsgade 1, 2100 København Ø

Who trains here
Mon 15:30 to 16:30 Sparks, Mon 16:30 to 18:00 U13 Academy + Junior + U13 from 19 Oct, Tue + Thu 15:30 to 16:30 Mini, Tue + Thu 16:30 to 18:00 Junior + U13
Good to know
The gym is at Sionsgade 1 on Østerbro, not on Strandvejen. On Mondays we collect Sparks girls from the school’s SFO before training.

Mini + Junior · Sparks · Academy

Kulturhuset Indre By

Charlotte Ammundsens Plads 3, 1359 København K

Who trains here
Tue + Wed 16:00 to 18:00 U13 Academy + U15 + U17, Sat 10:00 to 11:00 Mini, Sat 11:00 to 12:00 Junior, Sat 12:00 to 13:00 Family Time
Good to know
Central, easy on public transport, and a short walk from Nørreport.

Saturdays · Academy

Nørre Fælled Skole

Biskop Krags Vænge 7, 2200 København N

Who trains here
Fri 18:45 to 21:00 U19 + Men from 23 Oct
Good to know
A big hall with three courts and eight hoops. Talata Night home games are here on Fridays, and our 2026 summer camps ran here.

Hafnia-Hallen Holiday camps only

Julius Andersensvej 6, 2450 København SV
